caseName: Great Cove Realty Co., Inc. v. Harry C. Brenner, District Attorney of County of Suffolk
caseNameFull: GREAT COVE REALTY CO., INC., Et Al. v. BRENNER, DISTRICT ATTORNEY, SUFFOLK COUNTY, Et Al.
attorneys: Arthur Karger for appellants., John P, Cohalan, Jr. for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
